decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan, block plan, PD/S1 01 Rev A, PD/SI 02 Rev A, PD/SI 03 Rev A, PD/SI 04 Rev A received on 12/02/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side and rear walls of the extension and outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the property or outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 158 Wentworth Road (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and new garage
